title: Daily News Brief — Oct 26, 2026: Issuer objections to OKX ICE stock tokens hit 22
summary:
Weekend edition covering Friday, October 23 through Monday morning, October 26, 2026. Objections to the OKX ICE tokenized stock venue climb to 22 of 62 issuers, including Wells Fargo, Cisco and Arm, as a Wall Street Journal ad warns CEOs against stock tokenization. Hyperliquid opens eleven offshore share-backed equity tokens from EQX Labs, and OpenWorld's Blockchain Common Stock on Figure OPEN stays on track for Q4 — two direct challenges to the DTC-centered settlement model. Stablecoin supply falls to about $300 billion and tokenized Treasuries shrink, while Anchorpoint slows its Hong Kong dollar stablecoin retail launch. Also: South Korea moves stablecoins under FX law, China targets a national blockchain network by 2030, Senator Blumenthal presses Tether, and Ethereum postpones Glamsterdam on the Hoodi testnet.

title: Daily News Brief — Oct 23, 2026: OCC finalizes GENIUS Act rule; JPM Coin comes to Ethereum
summary:
Week in review for October 19–23, 2026, and the first episode with the new digital cash segment. The OCC finalizes its GENIUS Act stablecoin rule with looser liquidity, reserve and yield terms; JPMorgan brings JPM Coin to Ethereum mainnet; the SEC names tokenization in its fiscal 2027 exam priorities; and sixteen issuers object to their stock trading on OKX ICE. Also: the DTC Tokenization Service details, BlackRock's push for tokenized money funds as collateral, ESMA's tokenised collateral call for evidence, HSBC RedCoin, SoFi's tokenized deposit, and BLOOM's expansion.
